mapper.select: select to_char(a.cr_acptdate,'yyyy/mm/dd hh24:mi') acptdate, a.cr_acptno,a.cr_sayu,b.cm_sysmsg,c.cm_username,d.cm_codename status from cmm0020 d,cmm0040 c,cmm0030 b,cmr1000 a where a.cr_qrycd='04' and a.cr_prcdate is null and a.cr_syscd=b.cm_syscd and a.cr_editor=c.cm_userid and d.cm_macode='CMR1000' and d.cm_micode=a.cr_status order by a.cr_acptdate desc
